evidence_quotes: Guangxi Jingui Pulp & Paper Co., Ltd. has selected Valmet to deliver two complete bleached chemi-thermomechanical pulping (BCTMP) lines to its mill in Qinzhou, China.
The order was included in Valmet’s orders received for the second quarter of 2026
